Open-weight reranker from the Qwen team, served by the network's vLLM through `/v1/rerank`. The default reranker of the skill.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `reranker-model` |
| Version | `e61197ed45024b0ed8a2d74b80b4d909f1255473` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |
| Install | `hf download Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B --revision e61197ed45024b0ed8a2d74b80b4d909f1255473 --local-dir ./qwen3-reranker` on the connected side, then `vllm serve /srv/models/qwen3-reranker` with the documented overrides on the inside |
| Evidence | docs |
| Last verified | 2026-11-24 |

The Version is the `sha` of the Hugging Face model record, read 2026-11-24 (https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B).

| Property | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Parameters | 596M, BF16 | https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-8B?blobs=true and the 0.6B equivalent |
| Max tokens | 32K | https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-8B |
| Weights on disk | 1.19 GB | https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-8B?blobs=true |
| Languages | "100+ languages"; the Qwen3 base model lists Turkish | https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen3/ |

The score is a reason, not a promise: MMTEB-R 66.36 for the 0.6B (bge-reranker-v2-m3: 58.36). These are Qwen's own runs, reranking the top 100 results of Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-8B).

## Choose when

- The default: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B is the embedding model, and the reranker should come from the same family.
- Long passages matter (32K tokens).

## Avoid when

- No vLLM instance can serve it: Qwen3-Reranker runs on vLLM only. TEI does not support it; the pull request #730 is still open (https://github.com/huggingface/text-embeddings-inference/pull/730).
- The overrides below cannot be passed: use `bge-reranker-v2-m3`, which needs none.

## Configuration

Serving, on an instance of the architect's `vllm` entry (v0.34.0), with the overrides the vLLM docs give (https://docs.vllm.ai/en/stable/models/pooling_models/scoring/):

```
vllm serve /srv/models/qwen3-reranker --runner pooling --hf_overrides '{"architectures":["Qwen3ForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token":["no","yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker":true}'
```

vLLM's `/v1/rerank` (also `/rerank` and `/v2/rerank`) matches Open WebUI's external reranker format. TEI's `/rerank` does not: it takes `{query, texts}` and returns `[{index, score}]`, while Open WebUI sends `{model, query, documents, top_n}` and expects `results[].index/relevance_score` (https://docs.openwebui.com/reference/env-configuration).

Open WebUI: `ENABLE_RAG_HYBRID_SEARCH=true`, `RAG_RERANKING_ENGINE=external`, `RAG_EXTERNAL_RERANKER_URL` (the full URL including `/v1/rerank`), `RAG_EXTERNAL_RERANKER_API_KEY` (from the environment), `RAG_RERANKING_MODEL` (sent as `model`) and `RAG_EXTERNAL_RERANKER_TIMEOUT`.

## Egress switches

| Connection | Default | Switch | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hugging Face Hub calls from vLLM and its libraries | on | `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` | https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/package_reference/environment_variables |
| vLLM usage statistics sent to stats.vllm.ai | on | `VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1` (also `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`) | https://docs.vllm.ai/en/stable/usage/usage_stats.html |

## Caveats

- `--revision` takes a commit hash, branch or tag, so the command above downloads exactly the pinned revision; `--local-dir` puts the files in that folder instead of the cache and creates a `.cache/huggingface/` metadata folder at its root (https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/guides/cli). The folder name `./qwen3-reranker` is this entry's choice. After the download, the model record's `sha` should still equal the Version.
- Open WebUI's `RAG_RERANKING_MODEL` with a local Hugging Face model loads inside Open WebUI and, if it fails to load, turns hybrid search off; the skill uses the external engine instead.
- The `--hf_overrides` spelling is as the vLLM scoring page gives it; the serve page spells the flag `--hf-overrides`.

## Carry in

### Images

None.

### Models

| Repo | Revision | Size | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B` | `e61197ed45024b0ed8a2d74b80b4d909f1255473` | 1.19 GB | https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B |

Carry the whole `./qwen3-reranker` folder, produced by `hf download Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B --revision e61197ed45024b0ed8a2d74b80b4d909f1255473 --local-dir ./qwen3-reranker` (https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/guides/cli). Inside the network `airgap-transfer` copies it to `/srv/models/<MODEL>`, the path that `vllm serve` takes; `qwen3-reranker` is used here for `<MODEL>` ([`references/models.md`](/reference/rag/models/), Serving).

The runtime image comes from the architect's `vllm` entry. With a GPU, `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0` is already in the manifest. With no GPU (`hardware.gpus` empty), airgap-rag adds `vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.34.0-x86_64` (`v0.34.0-arm64` on arm64) as the section-1 row `vllm` (from airgap-rag); pooling models on CPU are `unverified` and checked inside ([`references/models.md`](/reference/rag/models/), Serving).

### Runtime downloads to stage in advance

None once the `./qwen3-reranker` folder is copied and `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` is set.

### Telemetry and egress to switch off before the first start

All rows of Egress switches, in the environment of the reranker instance.
